summary: Reports on the STRINT workshop, where about a hundred participants met in London in early 2014 to discuss how the IETF and W3C should respond to pervasive monitoring. Topics included terminology, user interfaces, mitigation classes and opportunistic encryption.

eli5.summary: Lots of experts got together to decide how to make the Internet harder to spy on.

questions: how should the ietf respond to pervasive monitoring
